text: In cart/editor when placing anything from the build menu, this is the current flow: select piece, place it, then after placing you can rotate it. but you cant move something placed around nor can you rotate a piece before placing, so its kinda this little shitshow between these two features that make building right now entirely unenjoyable.

events.text: Oracle and active cart/editor survey complete. The viewport already has modal Place/Move tools, but Move only selects and placement yaw is hard-coded; implementing a persistent ghost rotation plus a snapped placed-piece move interaction without touching unrelated in-flight editor work.

Implemented active cart/editor build interaction: R now follows the ruled mode-sensitive behavior (selected piece first, otherwise armed ghost); Move is a local 30Hz-preview, commit-on-drop transform that preserves instance data and uses the existing collision/undo policy. Verified with 5/5 focused tests, full bundle, ReleaseFast ship, and headless editor render.

resolution: Implemented the active cart/editor placement interaction: R now turns the armed ghost before a drop when no placed instance is selected, while retaining selected-piece rotation. Move now drags a picked placed piece through a throttled local preview and commits one undoable, collision-aware world edit on release, preserving its identity, transform facets, slots, and overrides. Focused placement tests, a ReleaseFast editor build, and an editor self-render smoke all pass. The shared worktree contains unrelated in-flight edits, so this review records no standalone commit SHA.
